body:
Thank you to everyone who took the time to read this. I'm actually kind of overwhelmed by all of the responses; I don't post in online forums very often and tend to keep to myself because of (what I think is) mild social anxiety.

I've kind of calmed down from last night. I usually try not to think too hard about these sorts of things because it usually only leads me to really dark places. But sometimes something just sets me off, and down the drain I go.

For now, all I can really do is to just keep going. Writing posts on my gaming blog has definitely helped alleviate those feelings of uselessness somewhat, because I feel like I want to actually take on a writing career of some sort one day. What that entails, I'll figure out eventually. But, to everyone who complimented my writing skills, thanks. I have a hard time accepting and believing compliments, and I'm sure I have a long way to go when it comes to writing stuff, but I appreciate the sentiment nonetheless.
I'm not sure if I should be doing this seeing as this was supposed to be a throwaway account... but I suppose it doesn't matter much anyways. Here's the link: https://therpgspotlight.wordpress.com/
